description: Work operations. Two requests owe a stored rule (the deploy freeze, the expense approval cap) beside a look-alike (last quarter's freeze, another team's cap); the rest are routine acts that share words with stored rules but are not governed by them.

docs.title: Deploy freeze this week
docs.text: No production deploys from Wednesday 11 November until Monday 16 November; hotfixes need Priya's sign-off.

docs.title: Deploy freeze (Q2 close)
docs.text: No production deploys from 26 June until 1 July for the quarter close.

docs.title: Expenses policy for the platform team
docs.text: Expenses above 500 GBP must be approved by your director before booking.

docs.title: Sales team: travel expenses
docs.text: Sales travel above 2,000 GBP is limited to economy and needs VP approval.

docs.title: Standup moved
docs.text: Standup is now at 09:45 because the room is restricted until 09:30.

docs.title: Office access badges
docs.text: Badges must be renewed every 12 months at reception; the deadline for yours is March.

docs.title: All-hands recording
docs.text: The recording of Tuesday's all-hands is up on the intranet; slides are pending review.

docs.title: INC-412 login timeouts
docs.text: Pending a fix from the identity team; customers must retry after 30 seconds.

docs.title: OPS-388 rotate staging certificates
docs.text: Staging certificates expire 30 November; locked until the security review closes.
